title: Equinox's Extra Create Recipes
description: Extra Create recipes because create lacks some
body:
# THIS HAS ONLY BEEN TESTED ON NEOFORGE 1.21.1 BUT IN THEORY SHOULD WORK WITH ALL CREATE VERSIONS

This datapack adds some recipes to the create mod that I feel should already be in the mod

The current recipes are:

Netherwart + Cobblestone = Netherrack (Mixing Recipe)

More Recipes are coming soon

You’re free to use, modify, and share this datapack however you like, including in public packs or videos. Just credit me somewhere visible.
